# Voyager Therapeutics Announces Appointment of Beth Shafer as Chief Business Officer


by[s2desi5_voyagertherapeutics](https://www.voyagertherapeutics.com/author/s2desi5_voyagertherapeutics/)


| Aug 7, 2023


|[Uncategorized](https://www.voyagertherapeutics.com/category/uncategorized/)


CAMBRIDGE, Mass. , Aug. 07, 2023 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Voyager Therapeutics , Inc. (NASDAQ: VYGR), a biotechnology company dedicated to breaking through barriers in gene therapy and neurology, today announced the appointment of Beth Shafer , Ph.D., M.A., M.Phil ., as Chief Business Officer (CBO).
